message:
fix(capture): stream recordings to a temp WAV instead of buffering f32 in RAM (#235) (#289)

Long recordings no longer grow an unbounded VecDeque<f32> in memory:
the capture worker encodes each WASAPI packet to PCM16 and appends it
to recording-<pid>-<ms>.part under recordings/, patching the RIFF
header on finalize. capture_stop renames the temp to the user-facing
name (copy fallback across volumes); cancel/error paths delete it, and
capture_start prunes orphaned .part files from crashed sessions.

Also fixes two correctness issues in the new path:
- s.frames now counts only frames actually written, so the patched
  WAV data_len always matches the file contents (previously a
  limit-reached recording would write a header claiming more data
  than the file held).
- the silence/peak pass iterates real written frames instead of
  indexing by num_frames, so nonstandard block_align or unknown
  formats cannot panic the worker; nChannels is clamped to >=1.

Not compile-verified locally (no working VC linker in this env);
rustfmt parse + manual review only.
